name: Odaka Chinatsu
source:
Chinatsu is the wife of [url=https://vndb.org/c57227]Kousuke[/url].

After a fire burns down their appartment, they are hosted by Kousuke's boss, [url=https://vndb.org/c57230]Kaizuka Hidetaka[/url] and his wife [url=https://vndb.org/c57229]Fumiko[/url].

She is a housewife who leads an active lifestyle and enjoys jogging to keep herself in shape, however she is envious of Fumiko's skill with maintaining the house.
